The UAE said it intercepted an Iranian drone over its waters, and the EU pledged at the G20 to maintain economic pressure on Iran alongside the US. Separately, Russia has reportedly been secretly supplying Iran with supersonic cruise missile technology, marking a significant deepening of Russia-Iran military cooperation. This follows earlier US cancellation of a joint marine exercise with South Korea and new Treasury sanctions targeting Iran-linked banks.
